author: Kaycee Sloan
title: Keurig Dr Pepper announces 5 unique soda flavors, 1 Kroger exclusive - NewsBreak
text:
By Kaycee Sloan ,
9 hours ago Dirty sodas have become all the rage, and Keurig Dr Pepper is taking advantage of it.
In a Feb. 18 press release , the beverage giant announced the return of several fan-favorite soda flavors, including a flavor you can only get at Kroger, the Cincinnati-based grocer . From Dr Pepper to 7UP, the flavors hit shelves soon.
These soda flavors are releasing soon Keurig Dr Pepper officially revealed it's bringing back unique dirty soda flavors in 2026, including Dr Pepper Creamy Coconut and 7UP Shirley Temple.
Those returning flavors will be available as limited-time offers once again, according to a press release . Here's when you can expect the drinks to hit shelves.
Dr Pepper Creamy Coconut
Dr Pepper fans will once again be able to indulge in the creamy, coconut-flavored beverage, which was originally released as a summer 2024 exclusive. However, the flavor is so popular the company has brought it back two years in a row.
The decadently "dirty" fan‑favorite is slated to return in full and zero-sugar options in April .
7UP Shirley Temple and 7UP Endless Summer Mandarin Orange
Rounding out the new soda lineups are two 7UP favorites, one of which you can only get at Kroger stores: Shirley Temple and Endless Summer.
This year's 7UP Endless Summer flavor, Mandarin Orange, is a new citrus-inspired flavor featuring a "bright mix of mandarin and classic lemon‑lime flavors." The drink is expected to return as a seasonal flavor ahead of the summer and is exclusive to Kroger. While an exact release date was not given, last year's Endless Summer flavor was spotted on shelves in April , according to Parade . It will also have a zero-sugar option.
The 7UP Shirley Temple flavor will return once again as a holiday exclusive .
A&W Root Beer Float
Another dessert-flavored A&W Root Beer will hit stores this summer. Following last year's release of A&W's ice cream sundae flavor, the company took it up a notch and turned the classic root beer dessert into its own classic drink flavor.
"Enjoy all the creamy, vanilla‑kissed flavor of a classic float without the fuss: no spoon, no ice cream, mess – just pop and enjoy," the press release reads.
The all-new flavor will be available in full and zero-sugar options in July .
Canada Dry Fruit Splash Strawberry
Canada Dry Fruit Splash Strawberry will also make a big comeback and will be sold on its own for the first time ever. The flavor first debuted in a summer variety pack in 2025 and quickly became a favorite. Now, the drink is getting its own single bottles and 12-can packs.
The strawberry-flavored drink is rolling out nationally in February .
This article originally appeared on Cincinnati Enquirer: Keurig Dr Pepper announces 5 unique soda flavors, 1 Kroger exclusive
